segments.description: Community banking through United Bank, offering deposits, loans, trust, brokerage and digital banking services to consumer and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, United's business activities are confined to one operating segment, United Bank, and one reportable segment, community banking.

revenueModel.text: United earns revenue from customers who hold deposits, borrow through personal, commercial and real estate loans, and use its trust, brokerage and other banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: Included among the banking services offered are the acceptance of deposits in checking, savings, time and money market accounts; the making and servicing of personal, commercial, and floor plan loans; and the making of construction and real estate loans.

changes.text: In the first quarter of 2024, United consolidated the mortgage origination and sales business of George Mason and Crescent with United Bank, reducing reportable segments from two to one.
changes.evidence: However, during the first quarter of 2024, United consolidated the mortgage origination and sales business of George Mason and Crescent with that of United Bank.

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of 2023, United exited the third-party origination business.
changes.evidence: United previously exited the third-party origination ("TPO") business during the fourth quarter of 2023.
